description:
Paracetamol or ibuprofen dose for a child by weight, read from fixed tables: the model is never involved in a number. Takes the brand printed on the bottle (35 brands across 57 countries: Calpol, Tylenol, Crocin, Panadol, Apiretal, Dalsy, Nurofen, Advil and more) or the generic name, and returns the mg range, the millilitres for each strength sold, the interval, the daily maximum and the age warnings. Refuses and refers when the child is too young to be medicated at home.

Use when asked how much paracetamol (acetaminophen) or ibuprofen to give a child; needs the weight. For fluids in vomiting or diarrhoea use oral_rehydration_plan; for any other medicine use paediatric_question_with_sources.

inputSchema.description: Which medicine, for a child of what weight and age.

age_months.description: Age in months, if known: it changes the warnings and can refuse the dose

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of where the bottle was bought: the strength sold there is listed first (in Haiti and the Dominican Republic children's ibuprofen is 200 mg/5 ml, twice the usual)

drug.description: Brand printed on the bottle (Calpol, Tylenol, Crocin, Panadol, Apiretal, Dalsy, Nurofen, Advil…) or the generic name: paracetamol (acetaminophen) or ibuprofen. Only those two medicines are covered; an unknown name returns an error that lists the names it accepts.

weight_kg.description: The child's weight in kilograms, 1 to 120; the dose is calculated from it

name: child_medicine_dose

outputSchema.description: The dose read from a fixed table, with the millilitres for each presentation sold and its limits.

disclaimer.description: Information from published guidelines, not a prescription

generic.description: The active substance the brand resolves to

interval_hours.description: Minimum and maximum hours between doses

max_doses_per_day.description: Hard ceiling of doses in 24 hours

mg_max.description: Upper end of the dose in milligrams for this weight

mg_min.description: Lower end of the dose in milligrams for this weight

refer.description: true when the child must be seen instead of medicated at home

warnings.description: Age limits and combinations to avoid

title: Child medicine dose
